charge_port.notes: Hyundai US free-adapter list includes the KONA Electric as a native-CCS EV; Hyundai says it has not announced a native NACS Kona.
Hyundai Canada FAQ names the 2026 KONA Electric as a CCS-port EV; MY2025-and-earlier Hyundai EVs use an adapter for NACS.

supercharger_access.notes: US: Hyundai free/dealer CCS-to-NACS adapter covers the KONA Electric (no year restriction stated on the giveaway FAQ page).
Hyundai Canada FAQ: CCS Hyundai EVs of MY2025 and earlier, and the 2026 KONA Electric, can use a NACS adapter (available separately).
